# IMPERIA COLD WAR — COMECON 1970 (one weekly and one monthly global tick; no country loops).
# Generated by Claude outputs/COLDWAR_CMEA_generator/build.py (do not edit by hand).
on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = SOV SOV = { IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes } }
				SOV = { COLDWAR_CMEA_initialize = yes }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { country_exists = POL POL = { IMP_is_1970_scenario = yes } }
				POL = { COLDWAR_CMEA_initialize = yes }
			}
		}
	}
	# the game spreads the weekly and monthly pulses of the countries over the week and the month;
	# the ticks run in the pulse of one clock country only, so they come exactly once a week and once a month
	on_weekly = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_initialized
					COLDWAR_CMEA_is_clock = yes
				}
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_clock = THIS.id }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_weekly = yes
			}
		}
	}
	on_monthly = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { COLDWAR_CMEA_is_clock = yes }
				set_variable = { global.cwcm_clock = THIS.id }
				COLDWAR_CMEA_bootstrap = yes
				if = {
					limit = { has_global_flag = COLDWAR_CMEA_initialized }
					COLDWAR_CMEA_monthly = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
